name: DatePicker
intro: Root supplies date state. Group Input and Trigger in Control, with Content containing the calendar views and tables. The visible input uses MM/DD/YYYY; valueAsString in onValueChange uses ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Owns selected dates, bounds, and calendar state.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Selects one date or a date range.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable calendar date.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable calendar date.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled selected dates. In range mode, index 0 is the start and index 1 is the end; either slot may be undefined.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected dates. In range mode, index 0 is the start and index 1 is the end; either slot may be undefined.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables date selection.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: ({ value: (Date | undefined)[]; valueAsString: string[]; view: day | month | year }) => void
props.description: Receives proposed dates, ISO YYYY-MM-DD strings, and the view. Unset range endpoints keep their slots as undefined and empty strings. Update value in the callback when controlling the selection.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Receives calendar visibility changes.

props.name: ids
props.description: Overrides generated part IDs. Input, label, and trigger IDs use callbacks, such as input: index => index === 0 ? "start-date" : "end-date".

props.name: defaultDate
props.description: Initial navigation fallback when no date is selected. Does not select or submit a value.

props.name: rangeAnchor
props.description: Fixed peer date for range markers and preview; independent of the selected value.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Makes the visible inputs read-only and prevents calendar editing.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the visible inputs required.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for month and weekday labels. Defaults to English.

data.purpose: Style the open and closed states.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: Receives a typed MM/DD/YYYY date. Malformed or out-of-bounds text sets aria-invalid; blur and Enter update native validity.

props.name: index
props.description: Endpoint to edit or open: 0 for start, 1 for end. Use the same index on each input and its trigger.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: Opens the shared calendar for the indexed input.

data.purpose: Style the open and closed states.

props.name: index
props.description: Endpoint to edit or open: 0 for start, 1 for end. Use the same index on each input and its trigger.

parts.name: Content
parts.description: Place the calendar views inside the popover.

data.purpose: Style the open and closed states.

parts.name: PrevTrigger
parts.description: Moves backward by one month or year in day view, or by twelve years in year view.

props.name: view
props.description: Navigation view. Defaults to day.

props.name: unit
props.description: Day-view navigation step. Defaults to month; omit in year view.

parts.name: NextTrigger
parts.description: Moves forward by one month or year in day view, or by twelve years in year view.

props.name: view
props.description: Navigation view. Defaults to day.

props.name: unit
props.description: Day-view navigation step. Defaults to month; omit in year view.

props.name: view
props.description: View to open.

parts.name: View
parts.description: Renders the day, month, or year view.

props.name: view
props.description: Selects the displayed calendar view.

props.name: children
props.description: Can render from the date picker API.

parts.name: TableRow
parts.description: Contains a row of calendar cells.

props.name: day
props.description: Weekday from the date picker API.

props.name: index
props.description: Weekday index from api.weekDays, used for its accessible label.

parts.name: TableCell
parts.description: Wraps a day button. Pass its Date as value to apply day-cell attributes.

props.name: value
props.description: Date from api.weeks. Omit value when wrapping month or year buttons.

parts.name: TableCellTrigger
parts.description: Selects a day, month, or year cell.

props.name: value
props.description: Use a Date from api.weeks for a day, a zero-based month from api.months for a month, or a year from api.years for a year.

data.purpose: Styles the active endpoint preview interval.

parts.name: Status
parts.description: Announces calendar status text in a visually hidden region.

accessibility: Provide a visible label and format hint. A typed date must be a real calendar date within Root's min and max; an empty optional input remains valid.
